headline: Kai, the rebound is holding — futures lean green with oil at $90, and tomorrow's payrolls will test the rate path.
subline: Wednesday's bounce carried into the pre-market, ADP and ISM services land this morning, and the 10-year sits near 4.78% ahead of Friday's jobs report.
asof: Pre-market · as of 6:40 AM ET · equity figures are futures · every figure links to a source below

items.title: Stocks rebound; Dow adds 324 ahead of payrolls
items.sentence: The S&P 500 closed Wednesday at 7,667.35, up 0.47%, with the Dow adding 324 points and buying steady into the close ahead of what 24/7 Wall St calls the next test of the rate path.

items.title: Jobs report Friday: 58,000 expected after July's decline
items.sentence: Economists look for 58,000 August jobs and 4.1% unemployment after July's reported 23,000-job decline, per the Trading Economics calendar.

items.title: ADP, claims and ISM services land this morning
items.sentence: ADP private payrolls (46,000 expected), jobless claims and ISM services arrive today as the last reads before Friday's number, per Trading Economics.

items.title: Ten-year yield holds near a 20-month high
items.sentence: The 10-year closed Tuesday at 4.804%, its highest in 20 months per Yahoo Finance, and sits near 4.78% in the pre-market per Trading Economics.

items.title: Bitcoin steady near $77,500, down 31% on the year
items.sentence: Bitcoin trades near $77,560, up 0.35% overnight per Trading Economics but about 31% below the $111,250 it fetched a year ago, per Fortune.

items.title: Tankers struck as Hormuz stays contested
items.sentence: Two supertankers were hit by projectiles minutes apart on August 31, and CENTCOM says more than 20 warships have redirected 82 commercial vessels since mid-July, per The Plain Truth.

items.title: US strikes 100 IRGC sites; Iran hits back
items.sentence: CENTCOM says it struck roughly 100 IRGC facilities across Iran, drawing retaliatory missiles and drones at US-linked bases in Jordan, Bahrain and Erbil, per Profile News.

items.title: Shutdown averted: funding extended to December 11
items.sentence: The House cleared the Senate's stopgap 370–48 on September 1 — four weeks before the deadline, which counts as early for Congress — funding the government through December 11, per Rep. Hal Rogers's office.

items.title: Russia hits Kyiv; Ukraine strikes Baltic port
items.sentence: Russian attacks killed 12 people in and around Kyiv as Ukraine struck the Ust-Luga port and the Novatek energy complex, per Profile News.

items.title: Oil holds above $90 after Tuesday's 5% spike
items.sentence: WTI jumped 5.2% to $90.22 Tuesday on the US–Iran escalation per Yahoo Finance, and holds near $90.50 this morning per Trading Economics.

items.title: Anthropic ships Fable 5.1, cuts agent costs 45%
items.sentence: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1, cutting agentic workload costs by up to 45% while tightening cybersecurity safeguards, per TechStartups.

items.title: OpenAI labels Astra a critical cyber risk
items.sentence: OpenAI classified its forthcoming Astra model as carrying Critical cybersecurity capability, requiring stronger safeguards before broad deployment, per TechStartups.

items.title: China's Enflame IPO draws 6,000x subscription demand
items.sentence: The Tencent-backed AI chipmaker raised about $900 million in Shanghai as demand ran more than 6,000 times the offering, per TechStartups.

items.title: Uber cuts 10% of staff for autonomy push
items.sentence: Uber eliminated 3,300 positions, about a tenth of its workforce, to flatten management and shift resources toward autonomous vehicles, per TechStartups.

items.title: Nvidia backs photonic chips for AI networking
items.sentence: Nvidia joined a $125 million round for Spain's iPronics, whose photonic chips target AI data-center networking, per TechStartups.
